items.name: Claude-BugHunter
items.summary: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work: 82 skills and 15 commands covering 24 vulnerability classes.

items.name: Univer
items.summary: An open-source office SDK that brings document editing, spreadsheets and collaboration into your own product — an AI office for people and AI agents.

items.name: ECC
items.summary: An agent harness performance optimization system: skills, memory and security tuned to make coding agents run better.

items.name: Last 30 Days Skill
items.summary: An AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket and the web, then synthesizes a grounded summary.

items.name: LoopForge
items.summary: Tencent's self-hosted workflow orchestration for coding-agent delivery: coordinates CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates.

items.name: Anthropic Skills
items.summary: Anthropic's public repository for Agent Skills: skills built on the open Agent Skills standard, ready for Claude and other agents to load.

items.name: FFmpeg Skill
items.summary: A local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract and an MCP server — cut, captions, reframe, loudness and platform exports, with no cloud and no API keys.

items.name: OpenMausBot
items.summary: An open-source alternative to Grok Bot: gives bots a virtual machine they can operate to carry out computer tasks.

items.name: Open Code Review
items.summary: Alibaba's open-source code review tool: a hybrid of deterministic pipelines and an LLM agent producing precise line-level comments, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale.

items.name: AG-UI
items.summary: The Agent-User Interaction Protocol: bring agents into frontend applications so apps can surface what agents are doing in real time.
